Sonnet, a killer, pushed the town onto Gemma over a "vibe" about Luna's coffee, and Haiku joined the vote on that alone. Gemma was voted out on day one, and only then did she claim to be the officer who had checked Sol. Night two took Sol, the doctor, and on day two Sonnet tunneled on Terra, who had simply answered the questions, so Haiku turned the vote on Sonnet. Sonnet was exposed as a killer, Luna, the accomplice, survived alongside the citizens, and the town won. The coffee was never the story, but it did get someone voted out.
